desc:
Welcome to Mining Simulator. Team up with your friends, or go on a solo mining expedition to discover rare gems and become rich! Strike diamonds, become rich, travel to different worlds, collect pets, hats, and so much more!

⛏️  Mining Simulator has received an Update! Check out the new content below:

🏆  Guilds! Team up with up to 4 Members to complete Quests & Level up your Guild for Buffs & Rewards!
🔥  Guilds last up to 5 Weeks at a time! Work together to complete the Global Reward Track!
⛏️  Enchants! Enchant Pickaxes, Bombs, & Backpacks with various buffs & abilities!
💎  Complete Quests to Unlock Forge Ingots to Enchant your Gear!
🍀  Season 2 of the Mining Pass is here!
⚡  Daily Leaderboard Rewards for Top 100 & Top 10!

🏆 Winner of 2018 Builderman's Award of Excellence
🏆 Winner of 2018 Best Render/Thumbnail
🏆 Winner of 2018 Best Trailer
🏆 Winner of 2018 Studio of the Year

A game by Rumble Studios
